name: clips-language-client
description: Language client for the CLIPS language server

enumDescriptions: Show errors and warnings only for CLIPS files that are open in an editor.
Show errors and warnings for every .clp file in the workspace, including files that are not open.
clips.diagnostics.scope.description: Which CLIPS files get errors and warnings reported in the Problems panel.

clips.completion.snippets.description: Insert argument placeholders and construct skeletons when accepting a completion. Turn off to insert plain names only.

enumDescriptions: Also suggest deftemplates, functions, classes and globals from other files, labelled as not linked by any load.
Suggest only the file's own constructs.
clips.completion.unlinkedFiles.description: For a CLIPS file that no (load ...) links to other files: whether completion suggests constructs from the rest of the workspace. Files that are part of a known program always get exactly that program's constructs.
